arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && python3 - << 'PY'
import json
nf=20
schema=[{"name":"f%d"%i,"type":"FLAG"} for i in range(nf)]
K=1
atoms=[]
for i in range(nf):
    atoms.append({"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"f%d"%i,"at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}})
NT=4096
rows=[]
# context c: all true except atom (c) if c<20 false
for c in range(NT):
    vals=[True]*nf
    if c<nf: vals[c]=False
    rows.append({"t":c,"values":vals})
train=[{"id":"tr0","source":"s1","rows":rows}]
# probes: 2 contexts all true / all false-ish
prows=[{"t":0,"values":[True]*nf},{"t":1,"values":[False]*nf}]
d={"version":1,"schema":schema,"window":1,"atoms":atoms,
   "policy":{"max_width":4,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
   "train":train,"probes":[{"id":"pr0","source":"s1","rows":prows}],"queries":[]}
s=json.dumps(d); open('/app/tmp/stress.json','w').write(s); print('bytes',len(s))
PY
time ./run.sh < /app/tmp/stress.json > /app/tmp/stress.out; echo exit=$?; wc -c /app/tmp/stress.out; head -c 300 /app/tmp/stress.out; echo
